pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.d4
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote Be2/d3 and 0-0; plan 4 overstated the d5-knight as a secure outpost. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.d4 cxd4 5.Nf3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White take with cxd6 (no c-pawn can) and accept an isolated pawn that only arises after cxd4 and exd6; plan 2 pressed a d4-pawn that is still Black's. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.d4 cxd4 5.Nf3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 challenged the d5-knight with Nb3 (no knight can reach b3); plan 3's a3 and b4 queenside expansion and plan 4's ...a6 and ...b5 were not this line's ideas. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.d4 cxd4 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 dislodged the knight with Nb3, which no knight can reach. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.g3
pages.notes: Plan 2 supported the knight with ...c6 while Black's c-pawn stands on c5. Plan 2 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-9 (reviewer: the first draft kept an unconfirmed ...b5-b4 idea); British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6, 5.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an 'open' c-file that White's c3-pawn closes; plan 3 recaptured with Nxd4 before the knight had moved. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6, 5.cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote Be2/d3 and 0-0; plan 3 named c4 as a move. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6, 5.cxd4 d6 6.Nf3 Nc6 7.Bc4 Nb6
pages.notes: Plan 3 named c4 as a move and missed that ...Nb6 hits the c4-bishop. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...Nf6, 5.cxd4 e6 6.Nf3 b6
pages.notes: Plan 2 pressured an e4-pawn White doesn't have; plan 1 pushed f4 through the f3-knight; the overview called it a Maroczy Bind and a Hedgehog. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Kh1 and Qe1 before castling and pushed f2-f4-f5 as one route; plan 4 said ...Bg7 challenges White's light-squared g2-bishop. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling elsewhere.
